title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field;
    postgraduate or certification (e.G., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night.


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android.
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device.
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection.
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required.
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards.
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development.
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart for cross-platform mobile applications.
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services.
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) implementation.
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques for background processes.
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play.
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services .
  • Familiarity with Firebase (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog .
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.Net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Web Developer
description:
React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise | Brazil - remote | Contractor


Job Overview

Our client is seeking a highly skilled React Web Developer with strong Strapi expertise to lead the development, optimization, and continuous improvement of our website and Headless CMS ecosystem. You will be responsible for rebuilding and enhancing the digital front-end experience using React and Strapi v5 , ensuring top-tier performance, stability, and scalability.

This role requires a proactive professional capable of taking ownership from day one—someone who can solve complex problems, implement robust solutions, and drive ongoing improvements across the platform. This is not an entry-level position.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop fast, scalable, and reliable front-end solutions using React and Strapi .
  • Rebuild, refine, and optimize existing website sections to maximize performance and conversion.
  • Maintain Core Web Vitals in the green, using real-user monitoring and observability tools.
  • Design, implement, and manage content structures, schemas, and data models in Strapi v5.
  • Integrate CMS features with analytics and marketing tools such as Vercel, Microsoft Clarity, HubSpot APIs, and Google Analytics.
  • Automate deployment workflows and repetitive development tasks to improve efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with design, content, and product teams to ensure seamless execution.
  • Ensure accurate tracking, strong server response performance, and a high-quality user experience across all devices.
  • Evaluate and responsibly incorporate AI-assisted development tools that enhance productivity without compromising code quality.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building front-end applications with React .
  • Advanced experience working with Headless CMS platforms , particularly Strapi (v4+;
    v5 preferred).
  • Proficiency with Vercel , GitHub, continuous deployment, and server-side integrations.
  • Solid understanding of API configuration and consumption within Headless CMS environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and deploy fixes in real-time production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion rates and running A/B testing experiments.
  • Strong knowledge of analytics tools and CMS integrations.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.


Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating and customizing HubSpot APIs .
  • Familiarity with SEO , CRO , and performance-driven digital strategies.
  • Previous experience working in high-growth or startup environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development workflows , frameworks, or tools.


If converted to full-time, you will be eligible for:

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective the 1st of the month following full-time hire)
  • Paid holidays annually
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Flexible working hours

title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.


What You'll Do


Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives


Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <
    99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency


Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management


What You Bring


Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment


Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction


Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)


Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge


Why Join Us


✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

✅ Career Growth: Clear pathway to progress inside the company

✅ Competitive Package: Industry-leading compensation aligned with performance outcomes

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Position Summary:


Our partner, a growing streaming and marketing optimization product company, is looking to add a BI Analyst to its team. In this role, your focus will be on analyzing operational business data and transforming it into meaningful insights and actionable strategies. You will collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, extract and analyze data from various platforms, and create actionable reports. You will play a key role in providing valuable insights and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization. Therefore, the ideal candidate should have a strong analytical mindset, excellent data manipulation skills, and a passion for transforming data into actionable business intelligence.


Experience and Education:


  • Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related technical field/experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a BI Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Experienced in SQL and advanced SQL queries, to extract and manipulate data.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and how to design effective data structures for reporting and analysis.


Skills and Strengths:


  • SQL Queries
  • MySQL
  • SQL Server
  • PostgreSQL
  • Power BI
  • Tableau
  • BI Analysis
  • Data Visualization & Reporting (Google Looker Preferred)
  • Business Presentations
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Python (a plus)


Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Collect and extract data from SQL databases using advanced queries and data modeling.
  • Utilize data analysis techniques to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights from complex datasets.
  • Develop reports to provide valuable insights to stakeholders that will support data-driven decision-making.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and identify business needs and document reporting requirements.
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools to anticipate future trends and outcomes, helping in strategic planning.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting by validating data integrity.
  • Maintain documentation of reports, queries, and data processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data-related processes, data quality, and reporting efficiency, resolving data discrepancies or inconsistencies.
  • Stay updated with the latest BI trends, tools, and technologies, incorporating best practices into work, to improve reporting capabilities.

title: Analista De Custos Pleno
description:

Habilidades: Domínio em ferramentas analíticas avançadas como Excel, Power BI, incluindo integração de dados Excel, Power BI, SQL e/ou planilhas automatizadas;
Pensamento analítico e resolução de problemas, gestão de prioridades e autonomia, aprendizado contínuo, proatividade, automotivação.

title: Analista De Inteligência Artificial
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países, liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital para grandes clientes. Somos uma das mais prestigiadas empresas de negócios e tecnologia da América Latina, com metodologia especializada e equipe técnica em automação e Hiperautomação.

Temos parcerias e certificações com plataformas líderes de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner com UiPath, Platinum Partner com Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner com Microsoft e Silver Partner com IBM. Nossa experiência e expertise em serviços de automação nos renderam, entre vários prêmios, o selo USN (UiPath Service Network) e o prêmio LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de IA apaixonado(a) por inovação para integrar nosso time de dados. O foco principal será arquitetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções de Machine Learning e Inteligência Artificial Generativa utilizando o ecossistema do Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

Você será a ponte entre a ciência de dados e a engenharia de produção, garantindo que nossos modelos não apenas funcionem em laboratório, mas gerem valor real e escalável para o negócio, aproveitando o poder do Vertex AI e dos modelos Gemini.


1. Responsabilidades e Atribuições

O que você fará no dia a dia:

  • Desenvolvimento e Deploy: Projetar e implementar pipelines de ML (treinamento e inferência) utilizando Google Vertex AI.
  • IA Generativa: Criar soluções utilizando as APIs do Gemini (Pro/Flash) e PaLM, aplicando técnicas de Prompt Engineering e Fine-tuning quando necessário.
  • Engenharia de Dados para IA: Atuar com BigQuery para preparação de datasets massivos e feature engineering.
  • Integração: Conectar modelos de IA com outras aplicações da empresa via Cloud Functions ou Cloud Run.
  • Inovação: Pesquisar novas ferramentas do Google Cloud (ex: Agent Builder, Document AI) para propor melhorias nos processos atuais.


2. Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

Indispensáveis:

  • Linguagem de Programação: Domínio avançado de Python e suas bibliotecas principais (Pandas, Scikit-learn).
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência comprovada em GCP, especificamente: Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Compute Engine.
  • SQL: Escrita de queries complexas e otimizadas no BigQuery.


3. Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

Para ter sucesso nesta função, buscamos alguém com:

  • Mentalidade "Problem-Solver": Capacidade de traduzir um problema de negócio vago em uma solução técnica estruturada de IA.
  • Adaptabilidade: O ecossistema de IA muda semanalmente. Você precisa gostar de estudar e se adaptar a novas ferramentas (como novos modelos do Gemini) rapidamente.
  • Comunicação Clara: Habilidade de explicar conceitos complexos (como alucinação de IA ou bias) para stakeholders não técnicos.
  • Colaboração Cross-Functional: Trabalhar bem com Engenheiros de Dados, Desenvolvedores Backend e Product Owners.


4.Diferenciais (Nice to have):

  • Certificação Google
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Experiência prática na construção de sistemas de busca vetorial (Vector Search) no GCP.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills;
    ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws;
    must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Coordenador De Rh
description:
RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Responsável por coordenar e executar todas as rotinas de Recursos Humanos na unidade de Fortaleza/CE, atuando como HRBP e ponte estratégica entre a operação local e o corporativo. Garante a aderência às políticas de RH, conduz processos generalistas (R&S, treinamento, remuneração, relações trabalhistas, clima, people analytics) e apoia as iniciativas de Segurança do Trabalho, assegurando conformidade, eficiência operacional e experiência positiva para colaboradores e lideranças.

Atuação como HRBP

  • Acompanhar indicadores de RH (turnover, absenteísmo, headcount, perfis críticos etc.) e propor melhorias.


Recrutamento & Seleção

  • Desenvolver estratégias de atração e relacionamento com talentos locais.


Treinamento, Desenvolvimento & Cultura

  • Apoiar a execução de programas corporativos de T&D, onboarding e trilhas de capacitação.
  • Mapear necessidades locais e propor ações de desenvolvimento.

Relações Trabalhistas & Sindicais

  • Garantir conformidade com legislação trabalhista e práticas locais.
  • Acompanhar demandas sindicais, fiscalizações e auditorias internas.

Apoio à Segurança do Trabalho (SST)

  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Segurança do Trabalho para garantir cumprimento de normas, treinamentos obrigatórios e ações de prevenção.
  • Apoiar campanhas internas de segurança, integração de novos colaboradores e controles documentais (PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT, ASO etc.).


Remuneração & People Analytics

  • Apoiar ciclos de avaliação de performance, mérito e promoção.
  • Contribuir com análises de quadros, faixas salariais, mapeamento de riscos e estrutura organizacional.


Melhoria Contínua e Projetos Especiais

  • Liderar iniciativas locais que otimizem processos e melhorem a experiência do colaborador.
  • Contribuir com projetos corporativos de RH, garantindo execução e adaptação à realidade da unidade.


Trabalho presencial em Fortaleza/CE e posteriormente no Data Center no Pecém (distrito de Caucaia)

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered . This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: Analista De Integração

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST).

  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).

  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).

  • Certificação AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
  • Azure Functions

  • Git/GitHub e CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

  • Integrações entre diferentes plataformas.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Aplicação de Design Patterns e SOLID.

title: Analista De Controladoria De Fundos
description:
Sobre a Prisma:

A Prisma Capital é uma empresa de investimentos alternativos fundada em 2017 que oferece soluções criativas para problemas complexos que exigem capital de longo prazo. A equipe da Prisma Capital é experiente, multidisciplinar e com um histórico de mais de R$ 12bi implantados com retornos atrativos. A Prisma tem um mandato de investimento altamente flexível que inclui um espectro completo de transações estruturadas, independentemente do tamanho, classe de ativo ou setor. A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.

Overview da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Controladoria com boa comunicação, senso crítico, com forte atenção aos detalhes e comprometido com a alta qualidade das entregas. O profissional será responsável por criar, implementar e acompanhar controles rigorosos para os ativos e passivos de toda a estrutura de fundos onshore e offshore da nossa gestora, além de coordenar o processo de auditoria e revisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis dos fundos.

Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);
  • Análise da rentabilidade dos fundos (Variações nos valores dos ativos e passivos, análise dos impactos mais relevantes);
  • Marcação a mercado de diversos tipos de ativos, líquidos e ilíquidos (Revisão e validação da precificação dos ativos em carteira, comparações com modelagens gerenciais);
  • Coordenação do processo de avaliação de ativos de Private Equity;

Desejável:

  • Coordenação das atividades de US tax compliance e reports de FATCA/CRS com prestadores;
  • Interface comadministrador de fundos offshore sediados em Cayman, Canadá e USA, instruindo e revisando a contabilidade, demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, Econômicas, Contábeis, Administração e Engenharias;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência anterior em asset management ou similar;
  • Diferencial: experiência em fundos offshore com investidores estrangeiros.

title: Plant Manager. Cabo De Santo Agostinho.
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin Brazil: Where purpose comes to life.

You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.

Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It’s time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to join us at Cabo de Santo Agostinho, Pernambuco, Brazil, in the Suape industrial complex . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

About the role:

The plant manager is responsible for managing the daily operations of the plant . This includes planning and coordinating production activities, managing a team of production department heads, supervisors and workers, and ensuring that the plant operates safely and efficiently. The production plant manager will also be responsible for controlling plant costs, improving production efficiency, and establishing and maintaining relationships with suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee plant operations such as budget, production schedule and stock.
  • Analyze production costs and inventory to establish areas for improvements
  • Ensure adherence to rules and workplace policies and HSE.
  • Lead improvement initiatives as aligned with global guidance, such as Lean and Operational Excellence , and other projects to improve quality, reduce costs, improve OEE, save time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or relevant field. (Nice to have: Lean Six Sigma certification)
  • 5+ years of experience in field as a Plan Manager in manufacturing (i n Plastic transformation processes).
  • Professional English level ( is a key requirement), the interviews will be in English
  • Experience in plant management and manufacturing operations, budget, Strong communication, management and supervisory skills.
  • The candidate will also have an ability to follow safety and compliance guidelines diligently in order to create a healthy work environment for all employees.

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Junior Founding Engineer
description:
The mission

Every year, over a million people move to the US on work visas. They're smart, ambitious, and excited—and then they land and realize the US is no longer made for newcomers.

It's overwhelming. The information is scattered across government websites, Reddit threads, and outdated blog posts. Every situation is slightly different, and one wrong step can cost weeks.

SettleKit fixes this. We're building an app that guides immigrants through US settlement step-by-step and use AI to automate it.


We're early-stage and have multi-year runway. We need a salaried Founding Engineer to help us build this.


The role

You'll be our primary full-time engineer, working directly with me (Max, co-founder). We're a small team—you'll have real ownership from day one:


  • Building features end-to-end. Our app is React on the frontend, Node.Js/Express on the backend, PostgreSQL via (currently) Supabase.
  • Working on our AI research pipeline. We use LLMs to generate workflow content from source documents
  • Thinking, not just executing


What's next for SettleKit and You

Right now, the app is in closed beta. Here's where we're heading:

  • AI-powered actions. We want to go beyond telling users what to do. Think: AI that helps fill out government forms, generates document checklists, or drafts emails to employers...
  • Mobile app. Vs. today's webapp
  • Broader coverage


What we're looking for

1. Must have:

  • Experience with graph-based, tree, or conditional logic systems—our core product is a decision graph that adapts to each user's situation
  • 2+ years building with React and Node.Js (or similar full-stack experience)
  • Comfortable with TypeScript and SQL
  • You've shipped real products
  • Strong communication in English—we work async-first
  • Based in Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, or similar)—we're focused on LATAM for timezone overlap with NYC and the strong engineering talent in the region

2. Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude)
  • Mobile development experience (React Native or native iOS/Android)
  • You've seen immigration complexity firsthand, or know people who have

3. What matters more than credentials:

  • You figure things out
  • You write clean code
  • You're excited about the mission


Why this role

  • Founding team. You'll work directly with the founder. Your code ships to real users immediately
  • Build something that matters. Immigration is broken. Help doctors, scientists, engineers, ... settle fast in the US so they can focus on their life and work
  • Learn by building production AI systems. You'll get hands-on experience building real LLM-powered products
  • (Almost) no AI slop. The product has so far been developed by human engineers, supported by Cursor/Claude
  • Compensation: Full-time salaried position, above market rate depending on experience.

title: Service Desk Engineer
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.


Summary


We are looking for a motivated and skilled Service Desk Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will deliver exceptional technical support to clients, ensuring smooth and efficient operation of their IT environments. Fluency in English is required, and knowledge of an additional language is a plus. This role suits a proactive professional with experience in Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and strong proficiency in tools such as Salesforce, Slack, and Office 365. An ITIL certification is advantageous and reflects a commitment to industry best practices.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Support


  • Provide first- and second-line support via email and remote tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving Office 365, Salesforce, Slack, and other business applications.
  • Log, track, and manage incidents and service requests across various platforms.


Client Interaction


  • Deliver a professional, customer-focused experience during all interactions.
  • Translate technical issues into clear, user-friendly language.
  • Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and ensure timely follow-up.


Service Management


  • Adhere to ITIL-aligned processes for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Monitor and meet SLA requirements for all client requests.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance service delivery and client satisfaction.


Collaboration & Documentation


  • Work closely with internal teams and vendors to resolve complex issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, changes, and resolutions.
  • Create and update knowledge base articles for recurring issues.


Tools & Technology


  • Use and support applications such as Office 365, Salesforce, and Slack.
  • Administer user accounts, permissions, and configurations.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices.


Qualifications & Skills


  • Fluency in English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • 2+ years of experience in an MSP environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or similar ticketing platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.


Core Competencies

  • Technical troubleshooting
  • Customer service orientation
  • Communication & documentation
  • Time management
  • Problem-solving
  • Process discipline
  • Collaboration
  • Attention to detail


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at

title: Servicenow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor


Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.


Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.


Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).


  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.


Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Product Designer Especialista
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

A oportunidade é para atuar em uma empresa líder global em soluções transacionais, que há mais de 50 anos conecta empresas, colaboradores e comerciantes ao redor do mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Designer com forte foco em criar experiências que conectem negócios e consumidores em soluções híbridas B2B e B2C . Você será responsável por desenvolver produtos digitais centrados no usuário, equilibrando usabilidade, viabilidade técnica e valor de negócio, com atuação estratégica em pesquisa e validação de hipóteses .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o processo de descoberta (discovery) em parceria com Product Managers, engenheiros e stakeholders, mapeando jornadas, dores e oportunidades.
  • Planejar, executar e analisar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas com clientes corporativos e usuários finais.
  • Transformar insights de pesquisa em soluções tangíveis — wireframes, fluxos, protótipos e testes de usabilidade .
  • Atuar em soluções híbridas (B2B e B2C) , considerando diferentes perfis de usuários, contextos e níveis de decisão.
  • Colaborar com o time de produto na definição de hipóteses, priorização e experimentação de soluções (design-driven discovery).
  • Garantir consistência visual e de experiência por meio de design systems e boas práticas de UI/UX.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento de uma cultura de design orientada por dados e pesquisa contínua.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Designer, UX Designer ou Service Designer , com atuação em produtos digitais.
  • Domínio de Figma e outras ferramentas de prototipagem e colaboração.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em User Research (entrevistas, testes de usabilidade, surveys e análise comportamental).
  • Capacidade de traduzir descobertas em decisões de produto claras e práticas .
  • Mentalidade data-informed , com foco em métricas de impacto (NPS, adoção, engajamento e retenção).
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para influenciar decisões estratégicas de produto.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência em plataformas complexas (marketplaces, SaaS, mobilidade, fintechs).
  • Familiaridade com Design Ops e gestão de Design Systems .
  • Conhecimento em experimentação e testes A/B .
  • Atuação prévia em pesquisa aplicada ou customer experience .

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

title: Analista De Planejamento Comercial Pleno
description:
O que é a Gerência de Planejamento de Centrais da Porto?


Integrando a Diretoria Comercial de Canais Diferenciados, a Gerência de Planejamento Centrais tem a atribuição de desenhar e acompanhar a atuação dos times das mesas de negócios e estruturas matriciais, buscando maximização de performance de vendas e produção, bem como de analisar indicadores, receitas, custos, resultados e eficiência da distribuição dos produtos para report e direcionamento aos executivos do Grupo Porto, Banco Itaú, corretores, gestores da VP Comercial e das verticais de negócios.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Gestão de Discagem: Criar, parametrizar e acompanhar as campanhas de discagem (Outbound) na plataforma NICE, definindo a melhor estratégia (Preditivo, Power, Progressivo, etc.) para cada carteira e objetivo;
  • Monitoramento eAção: Realizar a pilotagem em tempo real (Real-Time Management) da discadora, identificando desvios de performance (taxa de contactability , pacing , utilização de troncos, etc.) e realizando ajustes imediatos para maximizar o aproveitamento da fila;
  • Otimização: Atuar na análise contínua dos resultados da discagem, propondo e implementando testes A/B de estratégias, horários e segmentações para melhorar as métricas de conversão e contato;
  • Gestão de Lista(Mailing): Desenvolver a segmentação e o saneamento das bases de dados (mailings) a serem utilizadas na discadora, garantindo a qualidade e o uso inteligente dos contatos;
  • Distribuição deatuação: apoio e acompanhamento na disponibilização dos leads em tempo real nos baldes de atendimento nas ferramentas de CRM;
  • Relatórios de Performance: Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards (BI) detalhados sobre o desempenho da discadora e das operações comerciais;
  • Forecast e Dimensionamento: Colaborar no dimensionamento da equipe em conjunto, considerando a produtividade esperada e o volume de mailing disponível;
  • Comunicação: Apresentar os resultados e as propostas de estratégia para a gestão e equipes operacionais, garantindo o alinhamento de informações.



O que você precisa para fazer parte desse time:


  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Estatística, Tecnologia, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em Planejamento Comercial de Operações de Vendas, Planejamento de Demandas (Forecast) ou Planejamento de Contact Center;
  • Amplo conhecimento em discadoras preditivas, especialmente na plataforma NICE (ou similar de grande porte);
  • Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Conhecimento emCRM (Dynamics, Salesforce);
  • Desejável conhecimento de ferramentas de SQL para consulta e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Desejável conhecimento em indicadores de produção;
  • Desejável vivência com ferramentas de IA para desenho de soluções;
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, raciocínio lógico e capacidade de traduzir dados em planos de ação.

LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.


Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.


Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products either under leading global non-latex condom brands SKYN® under its local heroes such as LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control®.

LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017 , when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell.


As of December 1, 2022, Lifestyles is owned by Linden Capital Partners , a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on the healthcare industry.

comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente do segmento de Indústria.

A posição é focada em desenvolvimento de automações, atuando diretamente com áreas de negócio para transformar processos manuais em soluções digitais.

Não é um RPA puro. Não é um analista que depende de ferramenta única.

É um desenvolvedor generalista com foco atual em automações e transformação digital.

Entender processos manuais das áreas de negócio.

Traduzir essas necessidades em soluções práticas.

Desenhar e desenvolver automações fim a fim.

Implementar integrações com APIs e agentes de IA.

Criar soluções rápidas e escaláveis.

Garantir que a solução funcione e consiga explicar tecnicamente como fez.

Ter autonomia para entregar.

Perfil Mão na massa, construtor. Autodidata, curioso, em constante aprendizado.

Abertura para trabalhar de forma generalista. Consegue discutir tecnicamente o que fez e como fez.

Entende bem o negócio e resolve problemas reais. Sabe trabalhar com áreas não técnicas.

Praticidade e agilidade para criar soluções rápidas. Espírito inovador.

Não pode ter postura extremamente rígida ou “quadrada” de especialista que só sabe um stack.


O que você precisa ter:

Desenvolvimento em Python (principal), Não para análise de dados, mas para desenvolver aplicações, scripts, automações e integrações.

Experiência prática em projetos de desenvolvimento (não só participação).

Criação de soluções do zero, como:

automações que substituem processos manuais, mini aplicações, scripts, conectores usando API, páginas HTML simples com backend integrado.

Integração com APIs, inclusive:

APIs internas, APIs de modelos de IA, Copilot, ChatGPT (via API), agentes de IA com base de conhecimento.

Criação de automações em VBA e macros quando necessário.

RPA (qualquer tecnologia), mas não pode ser o único conhecimento.

Power BI – não como analista de BI, mas como suporte básico (integração, atualização de automações etc.).

Ferramentas ou áreas que podem aparecer no dia a dia: VBA / Excel avançado.

HTML simples para criar interfaces básicas.

APIs em geral (REST).

RPA (qualquer ferramenta).

IA generativa (Copilot, ChatGPT, agentes de IA).

Power Automate (pode aparecer, mas não é foco).

Pontos técnicos que o gestor reforçou:

Ele não quer alguém especialista apenas em uma ferramenta (ex.: só BluePrism, só UiPath, só Power Automate, só BI).

Ele também não quer alguém que só acompanhou projetos — precisa ter construído.

Ele procura alguém "com sangue quente para aprender", que esteja: estudando, se atualizando, experimentando novas tecnologias, acompanhando tendências de IA e automação.

title: Head Of Customer Success Engineering
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the Role:

We are looking for a customer-focused technical leader to join our global team! Based in Sao Paolo, Brazil, the Head of Customer Success Engineering, LatAm will serve as the leader of a team of product specialists (Customer Success Engineers) providing technical guidance during the entire post-sales customer lifecycle.

As the Head of Customer Success Engineering, LatAm, you’ll lead a team of CSEs, working with them to prioritize and resolve complex issues, mentor the team, and collaborate with internal teams to drive product improvements, process efficiencies, and market growth. With your technical expertise and leadership, you’ll play a key role in elevating the customer experience in the region.

This is a role with a strong client-facing component. You’ll be expected to spend at least three days per week working from a local Optibus office (if available) or on-site with customers. Travel within LatAm is required (up to ~35%).



Technical Delivery

  • Lead a Customer Success Engineering team that delivers technical value to customers over the entire post-sales lifecycle, including onboardings / implementations.
  • Ensure that projects and deliverables are completed on-time and on-budget, balancing customer requests with SOW and team effort.
  • Work in collaboration with PMO to achieve desired high-quality, on-time deliverables that provide customers value
  • Monitor performance of teams and provide timely feedback and development assistance
  • Risk identification and management detecting early signs of at-risk projects, designing mitigation plans, and creating a process and path for escalation and resolution
  • Provide inputs on forecasting on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
  • Drive the team to achieve their annual utilization targets


Process

  • Execute process improvements and the development of policies, procedures, methods, and tools in support of faster, more efficient technical delivery
  • Partner with the sales team, product management, and support to influence changes or highlight opportunities in products, tooling, and strategy through data-driven analysis of customer friction.


Reporting

  • Report on staffing, utilization, project health, and financial performance for all projects


People

  • Mentor and coach a team of high performing Customer Success Engineers
  • Responsible for team management, including hiring, training, performance management and engagement


Requirements :

  • Please submit your CV in English for consideration!
  • Proven experience : 10+ years in a customer-facing technical role (e.G., Implementation, Presales, Solutions Engineering, or Consulting) in SaaS or transportation tech. At least 5 years of experience managing teams.
  • Strong technical acumen : Ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences;
    familiarity with APIs, data integrations and cloud-native software.
  • Seasoned risk manager : Experience mentoring teams that manage a portfolio of time-sensitive projects simultaneously, demonstrating experience with developing and maintaining project schedules, risk management and mitigation, and mastery of change management
  • Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Spanish, and Portuguese , with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Collaboration : Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment, collaborating closely with Sales, Product, and Support team leaders


Preferred requirements:

  • Industry experience: hands-on experience with public transport, public transit, urban mobility, scheduling tools, CAD/AVL systems, or real-time monitoring platforms. This includes relevant experience in procurement and public tender processes in LatAm.


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.


Interview process:

  • Initial screening with the Talent Acquisition team.
  • Manager Interview with Global Director of Customer Success Engineering
  • Peer Interview with Head of Customer Success Engineering
  • Case study interview with Global Director of Customer Success Engineering, Head of Customer Success Engineering, Global VP of Customer Success and Head of PMO .
  • HR call

title: Executivo De Vendas Externas - Máquina De Cartão - Mercado Pago - Paraná
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.

  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

title: Líder De Equipe Comercial Externo - Mercado Pago -Paraná
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Nós lhe propomos:

description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.
